description: Resume-Job Match Link Features - Add 'Link to resume' and 'Link to job' input options allowing users to select saved platform data instead of pasting/uploading content.

userStories.title: Explore existing resume-job-match page structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to understand the existing page structure, state management, and input components before adding new features.
acceptanceCriteria: Read src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/tools/resume-job-match/page.tsx
Read src/components/tools/resume-job-match-client.tsx
Identify existing input tab structure and state management
Identify where resume and job content is passed to API
Document findings in notes field
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FINDINGS: (1) Resume input uses tabbed interface with 3 tabs: paste|upload|saved. 'saved' tab only shown when authenticated, uses ResumeSelector component. (2) All resume inputs converge to single 'resumeText' state. (3) Job description has NO tabs - just a simple textarea via JobDescriptionInput component. (4) State vars: resumeText, jobDescription, selectedResumeId, activeTab. (5) API: POST /api/tools/match-resume-job with {resumeText, jobDescription, locale}. (6) convertResumeToText() function already exists for converting saved resumes to plain text. (7) ResumeSelector fetches user resumes via Supabase with RLS.

userStories.title: Explore saved jobs data structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to understand how jobs are stored to implement the job selector.
acceptanceCriteria: Search codebase for job-related tables or types
Check src/types/ for job-related interfaces
Check Supabase schema for jobs table
Identify if jobs are stored per-user or as external API data
Document job data structure in notes field
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FINDINGS: (1) Jobs stored in 'job_applications' table (no separate saved_jobs table). (2) Key fields: id, company_name, job_title, job_url, location, salary_range, job_description, status. (3) Status enum: saved|applied|interviewing|offer|rejected|accepted|declined. (4) RLS enforced via user_id. (5) API: GET /api/job-applications returns user's saved jobs (id, company_name, job_title, job_url, status, created_at). (6) TypeScript type: JobApplication from src/types/database.ts. (7) For JobLinker: fetch from job_applications where status='saved' or all, display company_name+job_title, use job_description for analysis.
